title: Switch se roman numeral banao
solution:
function toRoman(num) {
  switch (num) {
    case 1: return "I"
    case 2: return "II"
    case 3: return "III"
    case 4: return "IV"
    case 5: return "V"
    case 6: return "VI"
    case 7: return "VII"
    case 8: return "VIII"
    case 9: return "IX"
    case 10: return "X"
    default: return "Invalid"
  }
}
hints: Har number ka specific roman representation hai
Switch default mein invalid return karo
